spellbook.finance/limitations: Workspace membership remains backend-enforced. The receipt counts held cards with status owned or listed; sealed units are not counted.
marketUsd is a market value from the TCGplayer market anchor. It is not sale proceeds, a buylist quote or cash received, and it carries no fees or shipping.
A copy with no market price counts in totalUnits and in the no_market band and adds nothing to any USD total. Read missingFields before quoting marketUsd as the whole collection's value.
unitAskUsd is null with askReason when no ask was computed for that row. Do not substitute unitMarketUsd for a missing ask.

description: Read one receipt for the cards a workspace holds: total copies, distinct printings, printings held two or more times, copies with a market price and their market USD total, copies and market USD in each value band, copies and market USD at one dollar and up, the market USD of the most valuable copies up to topUnitsCap, and the top rows by market value with card name, set, collector number, finish, condition, copies, unit market and the Intelligent Pricing TCGplayer ask when one was computed. Call it to answer what a collection holds and what it is worth in one read; it works for a free collection-only workspace and for a store. Call spellbook_inventory_holdings next for every row, or spellbook_buylist_compare for per-destination nets. It reports facts; it does not rank, score or pick what to sell.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose held cards to total, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.
